verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a single runtime that serves text, vision, image, video, voice and 3D models across multiple backends, from a gallery, Hugging Face GGUF files or Ollama, so broad multi-modal model support is evidenced. The breadth claimed in the story is not: there is no evidence of 'hundreds of architectures' and nothing about MoE or embedding models. Missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of supported architectures, explicit MoE support, explicit embedding-model support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: Text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D and agents, from one open runtime.
LocalAI supports running the OpenAI functions and tools API across multiple backends.
Install models from the built-in gallery (Discover page)
